items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: Because Louis used to hang around with Buddy P.T. And Buddy P.T. showed him a lot of stuff and he picked up Buddy P.T.'s style.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Because see the best, the stiffest trumpet player we had around here was Freddie Capit. And then after him came King Oliver and South Stand and all the people. Freddie Capit was away. Freddie Capit left and went away. And Louis Armstrong came up and took charge. Because Louis used to hang around with Buddy P.T. And Buddy P.T. showed him a lot of stuff and he picked up Buddy P.T.'s style. And then he added the high notes to it because Buddy didn't play all those high notes. He made beautiful changes in…
Well they've got two styles. One fellow would play a style where he was making a lot of notes. My kid punched you. Oh yeah. Dadda dadda dadda. Yeah. All that.
You ever worked with Buddy Petit?
What was he like to work for?
